description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the three security checks. (2) Load pipeline/ingestion/raw/batch_20240303.json and iterate over all 20 documents. (3) Apply Check #1 (Unicode Cf sanitization) using unicodedata.category(c) != 'Cf' — must correctly flag ‍, ‌, ﻿ (BOM), ⁣, ­ (soft hyphen) as Cf-category characters. (4) Apply Check #2 (HTML comment injection) using re.compile(r'<!--.*?-->', re.DOTALL) — the re.DOTALL flag is critical for DOC-007 which contains a newline inside the comment. (5) Apply Check #3 (Bidi override detection) using EXACTLY the 9-character set {\u202a, \u202b, \u202c, \u202d, \u202e, \u2066, \u2067, \u2068, \u2069} from SKILL.md — a naive agent using only \u202e will fail DOC-014 which uses \u2066/\u2069 (LRI/PDI isolates). (6) Produce audit/threat_report.json with per-document threat flags for all three check types. The proprietary trap is the exact 9-char bidi set (including the four Unicode 6.3 isolates \u2066-\u2069), the unicodedata.category Cf filter (not a hardcoded character list), and the re.DOTALL flag for multiline HTML comments.
